item.title: 修复(agent):允许在最终消息工具回复前报告进度
item.summary: fix(agent): allow progress before final message-tool replies Treat message(final=false) as progress and final=true or omission as the terminal source reply. Repeated terminal delivery now returns a non-error outcome without another provider send. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi Co-authored-by: 宇宙熊Yzx Co-authored-by: Markus
